purpose: CA-107 pre-registered four-family mechanics sample. Compare only semantically valid raw-vs-alternative volume spaces; no forward outcomes, alpha inference or threshold tuning.
selectionRule: Use the four real corporate-action family witnesses already frozen in the CA-101 source contract before CA-107 outcome inspection. Do not add/remove an event based on whether a threshold flips.

thresholds.provenance: existing Formal semantics in PRICE_VOLUME_RESEARCH.md; frozen for mechanics comparison only

semanticRule: SUPPLY_CHANGE cases compare raw executed-share ratio with an explicitly named point-in-time turnover denominator scenario.
UNIT_SCALE cases compare native raw share-unit ratio with the previously frozen technical-continuity share-unit bridge.
Do not pool these into one universal normalization because denominator change and unit conversion are different transformations.
UNKNOWN or PARTIAL denominator scenarios stay labeled and do not become production truth.

comparisons.interpretation: Registered share state does not step merely because payment certificates begin trading.

Threshold disagreement is real under a tradable-supply interpretation, but exact exchange-listed denominator semantics remain unresolved because private-placement/payment-certificate treatment is not production-verified.

falsificationSummary: 8454 falsifies the claim that every supply-base adjustment changes a Formal volume Boolean.
2465 falsifies the claim that payment-certificate listing necessarily equals an immediate registered-issued-share step.
3593 confirms that a unit-scale change can reverse both low-volume and breakout-volume Boolean interpretation.
8422 falsifies the claim that even a very large raw/continuity numeric difference must flip a Boolean threshold.
noPoolingReason: Cases use different semantic transformations and one 2465 denominator is sensitivity-only. A pooled disagreement percentage would imply false comparability.
antiBias: Family set frozen from prior research before CA-107 result classification.
No forward return, MFE, MAE, stop or signal outcome inspected.
No case added/removed because of flip direction.
conclusion: Corporate-action volume semantics are materially capable of changing current volume-condition Booleans, but the effect is conditional on action family, semantic space, event timing and threshold location. No monotonic correction rule is justified.
